description: This file defines the JwtTokenGenerator class, responsible for generating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication purposes within the application's security infrastructure.

classes.name: JwtTokenGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates JWT tokens using provided issuer options and claims.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token string for a given username, embedding claims like subject, unique token identifier, and issued at timestamp.
